official_statement_rationale: While headline CPI inflation at 5.55 per cent remains within the tolerance band, it is uncomfortably close to the upper threshold, and the persistence of food inflation at 8.70 per cent, exacerbated by the 6.0 per cent monsoon deficit, necessitates continued vigilance. The positive output gap of 0.60 per cent and the resilience of our 6.50 per cent GVA growth indicate that the economy can sustain the current policy stance. A shift to a neutral stance at this juncture would be premature and could risk unanchoring inflation expectations. Therefore, I vote to maintain the policy repo rate at 6.50 per cent and continue with the stance of withdrawal of accommodation to ensure that inflation aligns durably with our 4.00 per cent target.
